import struct, zlib

def chunk\(name, data\):
    c = name + data
    return struct.pack\('>I', len\(data\)\) + c + struct.pack\('>I', zlib.crc32\(c\) & 0xffffffff\)

def make_png\(size, bg=\(255,107,43\)\):
    sig = b'\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n'
    ihdr = chunk\(b'IHDR', struct.pack\('>IIBBBBB', size, size, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0\)\)
    r,g,b = bg
    row = bytes\([0] + [r,g,b]*size\)
    idat = chunk\(b'IDAT', zlib.compress\(row*size, 9\)\)
    iend = chunk\(b'IEND', b''\)
    return sig + ihdr + idat + iend

import os
os.makedirs\('public', exist_ok=True\)

with open\('public/icon-192.png', 'wb'\) as f:
    f.write\(make_png\(192\)\)
with open\('public/icon-512.png', 'wb'\) as f:
    f.write\(make_png\(512\)\)

print\("✓ icon-192.png y icon-512.png creados"\)
EOF)
